name: Maximum Readout Bandwidth
description: Validates that PixelBandwidth does not exceed a configurable maximum, optionally only at a specific field strength (other field strengths pass silently).

testCases.name: High bandwidth at 1.5T passes (check scoped to 3T)
400 Hz/px fails a 300 limit applied at any field
Other field strength warns when configured

parameterDefinitions.name: reference_field_t
parameterDefinitions.label: Applies at field strength
parameterDefinitions.description: Only check at this field strength (blank = check at any field strength)

parameterDefinitions.name: warn_at_other_field
parameterDefinitions.label: Warn at other field strengths
parameterDefinitions.description: Emit a warning (instead of passing silently) when the field strength differs from the reference
